title: Research on the initial corrosion behavior of A100 steel in salt fog-SO2 environment
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5309-5324
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08480F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yong Zhang, Hanyao Xiao, Wenfei Yang, Weijie Fan, Andong Wang, Jia Li, Hongjun Zhao
A100 steel corrosion in salt fog-SO2 follows triphasic kinetics, forming dual-layer rust. Alloying and microstructure regulate resistance, but synergistic ions eventually degrade protection, informing its use in marine aviation equipment.
